first-time-dialogue.npc: Hello! You must be the human that's been helping out around here.
Well, I'm Nama, one of the elders who specialises in dealing with the gryphons.

first-time-dialogue.player: Pleased to meet you. So what brings you out here?

first-time-dialogue.npc: One of the more problematic gryphons has made a home in this cave. I'm here to keep an eye on it.

first-time-dialogue.player: I see. Perhaps I could help with that.

first-time-dialogue.npc: Help is always appreciated, but I wouldn't go charging in there without good reason. We don't want to anger the gryphon unnecessary.

first-time-dialogue.text: You can only fight the gryphon in this cave if you've been assigned to do so by a Slayer Master.

first-time-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.player: Hello there. How are things with that gryphon?

first-time-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: Thankfully it hasn't been overly aggressive so far. It's important we keep it in check, but we don't want to go overboard and anger it unnecessary.

first-time-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.text: You can only fight the gryphon in this cave if you've been assigned to do so by a Slayer Master.

options.text: Do you have any useful statistics for me?

steps.player: Do you have any useful statistics for me?

options.text: Can I come in if I have a clue scroll?

steps.player: Can I come in if I have a clue scroll?

steps.npc: A clue scroll, you say? Let me see...
Hmm... yes, that would appear to be this gryphon. Very well, I will allow you to fight it once, but no more than that.

attempting-to-enter-cave-entrance.npc: Sorry, but I can't let you go in there without permission.

attempting-to-enter-cave-entrance.text: You can only fight the gryphon in this cave if you've been assigned to do so by a Slayer Master.

attempting-to-attack-shellbane-gryphon-w.npc: Wait! That gryphon does not currently pose a threat to us. You shouldn't attack it without permission!

attempting-to-attack-shellbane-gryphon-w.text: Elder Nama wants you to stick to your Slayer assignments.
